faqs.q: Can you target both Gurugram tech employers and Manesar/Faridabad industrial plants?
faqs.a: Yes. We build separate messaging tracks for corporate HR/tech buyers (group health, D&O, cyber) and industrial plant owners (fire, marine, workmen comp, asset protection).

faqs.q: Do you work with funded Gurugram insurtechs selling B2B software or employee benefits?
faqs.a: Yes. We have booked verified product demos and enterprise pilots for insurtechs and claims platforms targeting both corporate employers and insurance carriers.

faqs.q: What if a prospect's renewal is 6 months away?
faqs.a: Those replies are gold in corporate insurance. We log renewal dates cleanly in your pipeline so your team runs a structured pre-renewal review 90 days ahead of expiry.

faqs.q: Do you generate retail B2C health or motor insurance leads?
faqs.a: No. We specialize exclusively in B2B corporate insurance, commercial lines, employee benefits, insurtechs, and B2B referral partner programs.

faqs.q: How does your Mumbai team collaborate with Gurugram clients?
faqs.a: We work with clients across Delhi NCR through dedicated Slack/WhatsApp channels, weekly KPI reviews, and live CRM/calendar integrations.
